title: Popcorn Clusters
description: Salty, sweet pink-and-white clusters of popcorn bound together with melted marshmallows and butter. Perfect party food.
steps: Line two baking sheets with greaseproof paper.
Melt the marshmallows and butter in a saucepan, stirring constantly so it doesn't stick.
Tip the popcorn into a large bowl and pour the marshmallow mixture over the top. Coat well with a wooden spoon.
Allow to cool slightly. Wet your hands, take palm-sized blobs and roll into balls. Space out on the greaseproof paper.
Let set for around 30 minutes before eating.
notes: Makes around 25 clusters. Per cluster estimate.
